title: Charmin Ultra Soft Cushiony Touch Toilet Paper, 24 Family Mega = 123 Regular Rolls, White
description: FAMILY MEGA VALUE: Pack contains 24 Family Mega Rolls of Charmin Ultra Soft Cushiony Touch toilet paper, each with 267 sheets, equivalent to 123 regular rolls for extensive bath tissue supply. CUSHIONY SOFTNESS: Enjoy the unique cushiony touch of this toilet paper, delivering exceptional softness without compromising the strength of your bath tissue for an enjoyable wipe. ENHANCED TEAR TECHNOLOGY: This bath tissue features wavy edges that tear more easily than ordinary squares SUPERIOR ABSORBENCY: Charmin Ultra Soft toilet paper is 2X more absorbent, ensuring efficiency and cost savings. LUXURIOUSLY SOFT: This toilet paper offers an irresistible softness you can feel, providing a premium bath tissue experience every time. SAFE FOR PLUMBING: Designed to be clog-safe and septic-safe, this toilet paper ensures peace of mind.
